description: Currency codes and decimals: ISO 4217 code, numeric code, minor units (decimal places), symbol and the countries that use each of 153 current currencies, including all African currencies (CFA franc zones XOF and XAF, rand area) and INR. Also display and cash decimals and cash rounding from Unicode CLDR 48.2. Filter by currency, country or region=africa. Useful for invoicing, payments and formatting amounts (UGX 0 decimals, KWD and TND 3). Returns JSON with asOf, count, results. Read-only; invalid input is rejected before any charge. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet), paid only when the call succeeds.

country.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country codes, comma-separated: returns the currencies used there

currency.description: Optional 3-letter ISO 4217 codes, comma-separated, up to 60 (default: all 153 current currencies)

region.description: Optional: 'africa' returns only currencies used in Africa (45)

name: currency_info_lookup
title: Currency codes: ISO 4217 codes, decimals, symbols and countries (153 currencies, incl. all of Africa)
